description: Follow up on applications that have gone quiet. action "list" shows the applications whose follow-up is due, most urgent first; "history" shows the follow-ups already sent; "draft" writes a follow-up for one application_id and spends tokens; "send" emails it to the address in to, from the user's connected Gmail or Outlook, under the user's name, and cannot be undone; "record_sent" records a follow-up the user sent themselves, for example on LinkedIn. Send only on the user's explicit go-ahead: show the exact subject and text first, then send it only after they say yes to that text. Sending needs a connected Gmail or Outlook; without one, the user sends it themselves and you record it with record_sent. On a timeout or an error from send, call action history before sending again. Do not use it to answer an email an employer sent; use getmattered_reply_to_email. Next: action draft for an application from the list.

action.description: list: the follow-ups that are due. history: the follow-ups already sent. draft: write one for application_id (spends tokens). send: email it from the user's connected mailbox (needs application_id, to, subject and body). record_sent: record one the user sent themselves (needs application_id and body).

application_id.description: The application, from action list or getmattered_get_applications. Required for draft, send and record_sent.

body.description: For send and record_sent: the message text, at least 20 characters. For send, the exact text the user approved.

channel.description: For record_sent: where the user sent it. Defaults to email.

cursor.description: For history: the cursor from the previous page. Omit it for the newest.

recipient.description: For record_sent: who it went to, an email address or a LinkedIn handle.

subject.description: For send: the subject line. Optional for record_sent.

to.description: For send: the recipient's email address, as the user gave it.

name: getmattered_manage_follow_ups

channel.description: email, linkedin or other: where the message should go.

draft.description: action draft: the drafted message. Nothing was sent.

applicationId.description: Pass as application_id to draft, send or record_sent.

followUps.description: action list: applications whose follow-up is due, most urgent first.

history.description: action history: follow-ups already sent, newest first.

nextCursor.description: action history: pass as cursor for the next page. Null on the last page.

notConfirmed.description: True when the user declined the confirmation and nothing was sent.

recorded.description: action send or record_sent: the follow-up count after it was recorded.

title: Follow Up on Applications
